title: Flatfoot in Hong Kong
writer: Lucio De Caro, Steno, Franco Verucci
actors: Bud Spencer, Al Lettieri, Enzo Cannavale
plot: In the Far-East, Italian police inspector Rizzo and American mobster Frank Barella co-operate in finding clues about the identity of a dirty cop in Rizzo's narcotics department.
language: Italian, Cantonese, Thai, English, Japanese, Mandarin
